goal: Prioritize the next feature to ship this quarter using RICE for a B2B analytics product

constraints.description: Must be shippable within the current quarter by the existing team

options.label: Scheduled Email Reports
options.description: Let users schedule recurring report exports via email

options.label: SSO / SAML Login
options.description: Enterprise single sign-on for procurement-gated deals

options.label: Custom Dashboards
options.description: Drag-and-drop dashboard builder with saved layouts

options.label: Self-Serve API Rate Limit Controls
options.description: Let admins view and adjust their own API rate limits

criteria.label: Reach (users/quarter)
criteria.description: Estimated number of users touched per quarter, scaled to 0-100

criteria.label: Impact (per-user)
criteria.description: Impact per user touched, scaled to 0-100 (massive=100, high=70, medium=40, low=20, minimal=10)

criteria.label: Confidence
criteria.description: Confidence in the reach/impact estimates, 0-100 scale (100 = high confidence)

criteria.label: Effort (person-weeks)
criteria.description: Engineering effort in person-weeks, lower is better
